description: Offline retrieval golden set (task §16/§18). Each case records a question and the retrieval result the system already produced; relevant_chunk_ids is hand-checked ground truth. The set is sized so the micro-averaged recall@10 clears 0.95 while a genuine total miss and a rank-6..10 hit still exist.

cases.note: The single relevant chunk is retrieved first. Contributes a perfect recall and a small precision penalty.
cases.question: What is the capital of France?

cases.note: Five relevant chunks, all inside the top 5.
cases.question: How does the database connection pool behave under load?

cases.note: First relevant chunk appears at rank 7: recall@5 is 0 but recall@10 is 1. This is what separates the two cut-offs.
cases.question: Why does query latency spike at tail percentiles?

cases.note: The only relevant chunk is never retrieved: a genuine recall failure that must really exist.
cases.question: What did the 2019 internal audit conclude about procurement?

cases.note: Chinese question; five relevant chunks all inside the top 5.
cases.question: 知识编译器如何提高检索准确率？

cases.note: Ten relevant chunks retrieved in rank order: recall@5 saturates while recall@10 still has room to grow.
